root_cause: A caller (pop3_perform) read a shared state field (data->req.no_body) to make a decision, while the callee it subsequently invokes (pop3_perform_command) is the one responsible for computing/updating that same field for the current operation. The call order was wrong: the read-and-decide step happened before the compute step, so decisions were based on stale state.
findings: Commit 4cd10ee28b introduced logic in pop3_perform_command() that recomputes data->req.no_body based on whether the outgoing POP3 command is multi-line (data->req.no_body = !pop3_is_multiline(command);).
